high_level_description: This image shows the internal components of an air conditioning unit, specifically focusing on the condenser coils. The condenser coils are metallic and have a blueish tint, indicating they are likely made of copper or aluminum. They are part of the refrigeration cycle, where heat is removed from the indoor air. The condenser coils are mounted within a white plastic frame, which appears to be part of the outdoor unit of the air conditioner. The frame has several slots and clips designed to secure the coils in place.
